name: mscse-thesis-does-not-transfer
description: §3.4 (Sept-2026 revision draft): 'Masters thesis direction (CSE 68901) earned at Notre Dame' — a CSE 68902 credit carried over from an earlier, unfinished Notre Dame enrollment is a master's project/thesis credit and does not transfer into a fresh MSCSE (DGS decision 2026-09-12, mirroring the existing Ph.D. rule). Only the 3 credits of CSE 68901 registered fresh, in this program, count toward §3.4's six.

CSE 68902: does not transfer into the MSCSE
